title: Pipeline sensemaking 1:1 — prep notes
content:
Context:
- Quick prep for 1:1 with Elliot (AE) — goal is to align on 3 deals to push this quarter and surface any product/SE blockers. Keep it short (30m).
- My posture: partner, escalate only the real blockers, offer specific plays.

Meeting logistics:
- When: 2026-03-15 10:00am PT
- Duration: 30m
- Attendees: Tessa Nguyen (CSM), Elliot Rivera (AE), optional: Marcus Lee (Solutions SE) if needed for deep tech ask

Top objectives (pick 2):
1) Narrow focus to 3 prioritized deals and commits for next 14 days (who does what).
2) Identify any capacity/fallback needs (Dedicated vs hosted) and draft immediate contingency.
3) Agree on a concrete customer-facing next step (trial extension, exec intro, technical deep dive).

High-level signals to raise (quick bullets to surface during check-in):
- Overall pipeline: signs of stagnation in mid-funnel (site visits → evaluation calls conversion down ~18% last 30d). Need to know whether AE has new value hooks.
- Recent latency report from BrightArc POC showed tail latency spikes at 95th percentile — flagged to infra on 3/10. Impact: exec concerned about SLA claims.
- Token usage for two key POCs trending 25% higher than forecast (billing risk if hosted).

Deals of focus (one-paragraph notes + concrete asks):
1) Lucidity Labs — $420k ARR opportunity (Q2 commit target)
   - Current stage: post-POC, waiting for procurement + SOC review.
   - Key blockers: procurement timeline (vendor risk matrix), SOC gap around HSM integration.
   - Customer signals: exec sponsor responsive but wants an integration plan and fallback plan if HSM delays.
   - Ask for AE: get exact procurement checklist items (Elliot) and confirm legal contact.
   - Ask for SE: prepare an HSM integration options doc (Marcus) and a short fallback summary showing Hosted + encryption-at-rest plan.
   - Next step: schedule 45m tech + legal call w/ customer next week. Owner: Elliot + Marcus. Target date: 2026-03-22.

2) NovaRetail — $180k ARR (likely split between Hosted API + Dedicated reserve)
   - Current stage: evaluation, POC in week 2. Low tolerance for cost spikes; showing strong interest on latency-sensitive endpoints.
   - Key blockers: unclear batching strategy causing cost overruns in POC runs.
   - Signals: engineering asked to see Optimize recommendations and quantization plan.
   - Ask for AE: push for a usage profile doc from customer (calls/day, tokens/call) — needed for Dedicated sizing.
   - Ask for Product/Optimize: quick config suggestion (batching + prefix cache) and expected % cost reduction; need deliverable in 3 business days.
   - Next step: propose a short RA/opt plan email to customer and attach cost scenarios. Owner: Tessa to draft; Marcus to provide numbers. Due: 2026-03-18.

3) Helix Diagnostics — $95k ARR (enterprise pilot)
   - Current stage: pilot, but security/legal questions escalating. They requested full audit logs + penetration test evidence.
   - Key blockers: pilot usage production-like; they want Private deployment checklist and timeline.
   - Signals: procurement is slow; deadline slipping.
   - Ask for AE: confirm whether they have Any existing hosting constraints (VPC or on-prem).
   - Ask for Security: request standard audit pack & guidance for penetration testing.
   - Next step: send tailored Private deployment timeline and package. Owner: Tessa + Security contact (cc Elliot). Target: 2026-03-20.

Open questions I want answered in the 1:1 (quick bullets):
- Which of these deals is Elliot personally greenlighting to prioritize? (force ranking)
- Does AE have exec-level commitment on Lucidity — calendar evidence? (need to escalate if not)
- For NovaRetail, do they have a firm budget threshold per token/day?
- Are we seeing similar cost overruns in other POCs or only NovaRetail? (pattern detection)
- Any hiring/resource asks (SE bandwidth) Elliot needs to flag?

Tactical playbook suggestions to propose (short, executable):
- Safety valve play: pre-authorize a one-week burst on Hosted with cost cap + automatic cutoff if cost > X (Ops can implement).
- Fast legal lane: offer a 2-week SOC review package (templated answers + prioritized contact) to accelerate procurement.
- Exec-to-exec brief: 20-minute call with our head of solutions + customer exec to reset timeline & risk perception.

Notes to self (how I'll run the meeting):
- Start with 3-minute status (what changed since last sync).
- Quick force-rank of deals (ask Elliot to rank 1–3).
- For each deal: fact-share (1 min), friction (1 min), ask (1 min), decision & owner (1 min). Keep tight.
- End with 5 concrete action items and owners + confirm follow-up meeting.
- Keep an eye on time — call out early if drifting.

Potential escalations and who to loop: 
- Security: Lina Ortega (sec) — for HSM and audit pack.
- SE deep-dive: Marcus Lee — for latency and quantization proposals.
- Product/Optimize: Priya Shah — for immediate config recs and cost modeling.
- Legal: Jonah Myers — for procurement / contract accelerators.

After-meeting: action tracker (will update and share):
1) Draft HSM fallback doc + share with Lucidity — Owner: Marcus — Due 2026-03-18.
2) Pull procurement checklist and legal contact — Owner: Elliot — Due 2026-03-17.
3) Send Hosted burst + cost-cap proposal to NovaRetail — Owner: Tessa — Due 2026-03-18.
4) Package Private deployment timeline for Helix — Owner: Tessa + Security (Lina) — Due 2026-03-20.
5) Ask Product for quick Optimize config + estimated % cost reduction for NovaRetail POC — Owner: Priya — Due: 2026-03-17.

Quick scripts / phrasing to use (keeps conversation crisp):
- "If procurement times are the gating factor, can we run a scoped pilot on Hosted with a fixed cost cap while we complete SOC?"
- "To avoid surprising billing, can you share expected tokens/day so we can size Dedicated vs Hosted?"
- "If the HSM path slips, here's a short fallback plan we can send to the customer today."

Risk checklist (1-line each):
- Exec sponsor churn: low/med/high? (flag high immediately).
- Legal timeline >45 days: escalate to Jonah for faster lane.
- POC cost unknown: set hard cap and notify finance if breached.

My personal follow-ups (after I update tracker):
- Put calendar hold for Lucidity legal+tech call (tentative 2026-03-22 9am PT).
- Draft customer-facing summary email templates (POC recap, next steps) — save to sales-scripts PR.
- Sync w/ Marcus 15m after 1:1 to align on technical deliverables.

Rough mental checklist before joining:
- Have latest POC logs for Lucidity (95p latency chart) — check CONFLUENCE-CC-4821.
- NovaRetail usage exports (tokens/day) — ask Elliot for CSV.
- Helix audit primer and Private timeline template.

Tone notes: be pragmatic, avoid over-promising. Use clear deadlines and owners. Pull levers: Hosted burst + legal fast-lane + SE deep-dive.

Unresolved / TODO in doc (my scratchpad):
- Confirm Marcus availability next Tues for Lucidity call.
- Update NovaRetail cost scenarios with quantized model numbers.
- Ask Jonah for a one-paragraph legal accelerator blurb we can paste into customer email.

End of prep — will tidy action tracker post-meeting and push to shared drive (shared_drives/customer-success) if any artifacts need to be official.
